title: Where the plan moved
description: Paired planned and actual intervals separate changes in start, finish and duration on a shared time scale.

props.name: data
props.description: Caller-owned { id, label, planned, actual } lanes. Each interval is a readonly [start, end] pair or null on one common numeric scale. IDs must be unique and nonempty. Complete finite ordered intervals render independently; reversed, overflowing or incomplete intervals are unavailable. Zero-duration intervals are ticks. Differences require both intervals.

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Formats absolute axis coordinates and interval endpoints. Defaults to en-US with up to two decimals. Date formatting belongs to the caller.

props.name: deltaFormatter
props.description: Formats signed actual-minus-planned changes in start, finish and duration, independently of absolute coordinate formatting. The default includes a plus sign for positive changes.

props.name: width
props.description: Total width in pixels; otherwise fills the container.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total height in pixels. Dense plots and keys scroll inside the frame.

props.name: animate
props.description: Finite native drawing using scoped motion tokens and live reduced-motion preference; defaults to true.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible title for the native chart.
